body: This PR looks finished to us: it merges cleanly with main, the body names the issue, the tests and the Changelog line, and there have been no new commits for some hours. Our review agents only review PRs marked **Ready for review**, so a draft waits without a review. When you think it is done, please click **Ready for review** (or `gh pr ready 2506`), and it gets a review in the next pass. If it is still in progress, ignore this comment.

We merged current main into this branch (maintainer edits) and marked it ready so it can join the merge train; no changes to your code beyond the merge.

The conflicts were all "both sides added a line" against main's new LinuxCNC post (#2303), resolved by keeping both entries: `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (BUILTINS, MACHINES, embedded table), `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` (POSTS, REFUSED, EXTENSIONS, the G55 synth-stream match arm), `crates/app/tests/control_comp.rs`, `crates/app/tests/wear_comp.rs`, `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`, `crates/post/tests/comp.rs` (stem lists now carry both `linuxcnc` and `grbl`).

Quick gate green on 4796fc991 (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, macOS): 705 steps, 0 failed - app + post lib unit tests and every app/post suite the gate map selected (the posting_files change maps to all app suites), including conformance, control_comp, wear_comp, machine, comp, bore_cycle and script_grbl.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4796fc9915ad123170ab74b38f700247748aaf77 -->
**Verdict: read, not built - needs a maintainer look.**

What was checked (read of head `4796fc991`):
- Clean-room: the header names the public sources (the Grbl 1.1 wiki
  behaviour pages and RS-274) and states that no Grbl source was read.
  The derivation is from our own `grblhal.cps`. The text is correct.
- The refusal law: bore and tap are refused before any move of the cycle
  is written; G41/G42 and tilted moves are refused by name; the note
  guard keeps user text from opening a control command. The recorded
  `.refusal` goldens pin each one.
- The line limit: every line fits in 79 characters. A comment is cut to
  fit; a motion line that does not fit is refused, never split. The
  dialect test proves no golden holds a G73, G8x, G98, G99, G41, G42,
  G43, M6, O or H word.
- The safety laws reach the new post: `grbl` joins the
  `first_traverse_clearance` and `expanded_bore_refusal` tables, and the
  tool-change reader names the M0 comment forms. The changes to the test
  code are narrow and correct.
- Body, Changelog line, decision file, `Fixes #2481`: all present. The
  issue is `in-review` with the author assigned.
- The one gate failure in the body is the old red main of #2483, which
  is closed. The goldens of that suite are green on `main` now.

Why it was not built:
- The author is not a collaborator. The self-hosted test runner refuses
  code from a fork by rule, and no local build is authorized for a
  review of this kind. The diff reaches the post and app heavy lanes;
  those were not run here.

State notes:
- The PR now merges with `main` (GitHub says MERGEABLE). The `conflicts`
  label is stale; the merge-time check restores the right label.
- The merged tree needs a gate (with the reached heavy lanes) before the
  merge, because the diff posts new G-code (safety floor).
